title: Sound effect
description: One-shot effects: impacts, footsteps, weapons, spells, pickups, UI clicks. Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX; several takes, the best kept, trimmed, mono, loudness-normalised.
prompt_guide: Describe the sound source, its material and texture, the space (indoor/outdoor, dry/reverberant, close/distant) and how it evolves (attack, decay, movement). One or two dense sentences, no story. Examples: 'Wooden door creaking open slowly in an old house, echoing interior' - 'Sword swing whooshing through air, fast motion, clean metallic tone' - 'Magical spell casting, shimmering particles, rising tonal energy' - 'Footsteps on gravel, steady walking pace, close perspective'. Set duration to the sound: impacts and clicks 1-2 s, actions 3-6 s. One sound per file; layer them in the engine.

param_help.model: stable_audio_3_small_sfx (433M, fast) or stable_audio_3_medium (1.4B, best quality, about 6.5 GB of VRAM)
param_help.duration: seconds to generate (1-120 with Small, up to 380 with Medium); silence after the sound is trimmed
param_help.steps: sampling steps; the post-trained models are made for 8, more does not help
param_help.candidates: how many takes to generate; the one that best matches the prompt (CLAP) and passes the checks is kept
param_help.trim: cut silence at the start and end
param_help.trim_db: what counts as silence, in dB below the clip's peak
param_help.loop: make the file loop seamlessly (the end is crossfaded into the start)
param_help.max_seconds: cut the result to at most this many seconds
param_help.channels: mono (sounds placed in the 3D world - engines pan them), stereo (UI, ambience, music) or keep
param_help.loudness: integrated loudness target in LUFS; null leaves the level alone. Starting points: SFX -16, UI -16, voice -18, music -18, ambience -24
param_help.peak_db: the peak never goes above this (dBFS); the gain is lowered instead of clipping
param_help.sample_rate: resample to this rate (e.g. 48000); null keeps the model's own rate
param_help.keep_candidates: keep every take in .soundforge/<name>/ next to the result

fast.description: One take at 4 steps: the quickest usable result.

max.description: Stable Audio 3 Medium, eight takes, the best kept.
